opening.argument: Several risk signals reinforce one another. The speaker frames trading as earning money while sitting at home, claims a minimum of Rs.800-1000 every day, and highlights a stated profit of Rs.870. Those are unusually concrete and recurring return claims, not merely a neutral explanation of market risk. The video then shows holdings, a sell order, and a route to create an account, while offering Instagram help to viewers deciding which share to fund. The combination of easy-sounding income, specific results, an external account pathway, and personal guidance can make participation appear safer and more predictable than the evidence supports. A trading screen proves only that a screen was shown, not that the advertised recurring returns are reliable.
